narrativeProgression.description: The video transitions from the man talking to a shot of the Earth from space.
The video transitions from the shot of the Earth to a map of the United States.
The video transitions from the map to a shot of a solar eclipse.
The video transitions to a black screen with the text "WHERE TO WATCH" in white.

text_to_speech: if you want to watch the April 8th North American Solar Eclipse here's where you need to go the shadow of the moon will start its path from Central Texas traveling up the length of the Midwest and crossing the Appalachian Mountains this region will have almost complete totality being in the center of the Shadow though nearby States like Florida will still have some peripheral observation I'd recommend watching because the next solar eclipse on North America won't be visible until 2044

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: If you want to watch the April 8th North American solar eclipse, here's where you need to go.
The shadow of the moon will start its path from essential Texas,
traveling up the length of the Midwest and crossing the Appalachian Mountains.
This region will have almost complete totality being in the center of the shadow,
though nearby states like Florida will still have some peripheral observation.
I'd recommend watching because the next solar eclipse on North America won't be visible until 2044.
